faqItems.question: Can I customize the templates after purchase?
faqItems.answer: Absolutely. Every template comes with full source code access and detailed documentation. Our team can also handle customizations for you — just reach out to discuss your requirements.

faqItems.question: How long does it take to launch my template?
faqItems.answer: Delivery times range from 4 to 21 days depending on the complexity of the template. During your onboarding call, we'll establish a clear timeline and keep you updated throughout the process.

faqItems.question: Do you provide support after launch?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Every template includes 30 days of post-launch support for bug fixes and minor adjustments. Extended maintenance and support plans are available for businesses that need ongoing assistance.

faqItems.question: Is hosting included with the template?
faqItems.answer: Templates are delivered as ready-to-deploy projects. We recommend and can set up hosting on Vercel, AWS, or your preferred provider. Hosting setup and configuration can be included as an add-on service.

faqItems.question: What payment options are available?
faqItems.answer: We accept all major credit cards, bank transfers, and PayPal. For enterprise templates ($2,500+), we offer flexible payment plans with 50% upfront and 50% upon delivery.

faqItems.question: Can I switch templates after purchasing?
faqItems.answer: Yes. If you change your mind within 14 days of purchase, we can switch you to a different template of equal or lesser value. Any price difference for upgrades will be quoted transparently.

faqItems.question: Do templates work on mobile devices?
faqItems.answer: Every SmartByte template is built mobile-first and fully responsive across all screen sizes, from 320px mobile displays to 4K desktop screens. We test extensively before delivery.

faqItems.question: Can I get a refund if I'm not satisfied?
faqItems.answer: We stand behind our work. If the delivered template doesn't match the specified requirements, we'll make it right. Custom-tailored templates are non-refundable, but we guarantee they meet agreed specifications.
